components.heading: Special assessments.
components.text: Any tax exemption granted for real property under this chapter shall not affect the liability of such property for any special assessments levied or to be levied against such property. (Ord. 17270 § 17, 6-2-98; Ord. 16349 § 17, 7-23-91. Code 1981 § 42-47. Code 1995 § 138-92.)
